exBody: Your answers are saved on this device. You can come back until {date} and pick up from the same question.
exBodyNoDate: Your answers are saved on this device. You can come back later and pick up from the same question.
readySub: {name}, this isn’t an exam — it’s how we see what you’ve learned since last month. Take your time and work on your own.
readySubPractice: {name}, this is practice. Don’t worry about mistakes — at the end you’ll see how many you solved.
resumeNote: {n} of {m} questions answered. You’ll pick up where you left off.
fTs: the clock starts when you press Start
fDs: the whole test is on this device
offBody: The whole test is already on this device. If the connection drops, just keep going: answers are saved and sent automatically once you’re back online.
how1: You can skip a question and come back to it later.
how2: Flag any question you’re unsure about.
how3: At the end you review everything, and only then submit.
startNote: The clock starts when you press Start.
adBody: A hint won’t improve the result — it only hides what {name} needs to work on. An honest blank is useful too: it’s exactly what the report will point to.
adR1: You may read the instructions aloud
adR2: Don’t explain the question or hint at the answer
adR3: No calculator and no phone helpers
adWhy: Home results are later checked against the in-person spring final, so outside help shows up anyway.
keysHint: Keyboard: 1–4 or A–D to choose, ← → to move between questions.
navHint: Click a number to jump to that question.
syncOffline: No internet. {n} answers saved on this device — they’ll be sent once you’re back online.
syncOfflineZero: No internet. Keep going — answers are being saved on this device.
syncWarn: Some answers couldn’t be sent yet. They’re saved on this device — we’ll try again.
syncSignedOut: The adult’s account was signed out. Answers are being saved on this device and will be sent once the parent signs in again.
rvSub: Click a number to go back to an unanswered or flagged question.
cfBody: Once submitted, answers can’t be changed. {n} questions will stay unanswered.
cfBodyAll: Once submitted, answers can’t be changed.
dnSub: You worked hard. Time to rest.
dnTimeUp: Time ran out — your answers were submitted automatically.
dnSendingBody: This takes a few seconds. Keep this page open.
dnSentBody: Everything reached our server. Nothing else to do on this device.
dnQBody: Answers are saved on this device and will send themselves once you’re online. Don’t clear the browser data until then.
whyBody: We don’t show a score or the correct answers. Some questions come back in later waves — that’s how we compare progress fairly. If answers got passed around in chats, that comparison would break.
fbBody: After the wave closes on {date}, the parent gets a report by topic and error type: what’s going well, where things get stuck and what to focus on this month.
fbBodyNoDate: After the wave closes, the parent gets a report by topic and error type: what’s going well, where things get stuck and what to focus on this month.
rp1: Error types — e.g. “stops after the first step”
rp2: One concrete step for this month
rpNo: No score and no question-by-question review
prSolvedSub: Practice results are just for you — they never go into any ranking.
prPending: Once your answers are sent, you’ll see here how many you solved.
ldTitle: Downloading the test to this device
ldBody: Keep this page open. Once it’s downloaded, the test works without internet.
erBody: The connection dropped during the download. Nothing is lost: any answers already given are saved. Check your internet and try again.
nfBody: This link has expired, or this test doesn’t belong to your account. Open the test again from the home page.
soTitle: The adult needs to sign in again
soBody: The sign-in expired for safety. Answers on this device are not lost — once the parent signs in again, the test carries on.
xpBody: The wave closed before the answers reached us, so they won’t count this time. It isn’t your fault. We’ll let your parent know when the next wave opens.
emTitle: This test has no questions yet
emBody: The test isn’t ready yet. Tell your parent — they can open it again later.
errBody: We couldn’t open the test. Please try again in a little while.
fbBodyOlympiad: When the stage closes and results are published, your parent sees a report: the result range and what to work on. Only your family sees it.
